anabelen.serreno: On the way to S-F13, Hugo Serreno tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Hugo Serreno answered the first call, number 45 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Hugo Serreno caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Hugo Serreno helped stack spare sandbags at S-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Hugo Serreno and Clement Wanter argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
A shell splinter the size of a fist hit Hugo Serreno at S-F13. He is alive and he is in pain, and he needs a bed.

Hugo Serreno drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Hugo Serreno helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Hugo Serreno did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.

The House of Serreno sent another. Felix Serreno, father of Hugo Serreno, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Volunteer number 45. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Felix Serreno's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Felix Serreno waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
The sergeant at S-F13 called out a range and a spot. Felix Serreno was the only one who hit it. Edmund Fts was badly wounded.
On dawn watch at S-F13, Felix Serreno fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Bastian "Saint" Rocco, now badly wounded.
bjl710: Day 4. The corporal put Edmund Bjl beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Edmund Bjl said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Edmund Bjl closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F5, Edmund Bjl listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

During a lull at the Brickworks, Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni called across from the Hegemony line. Edmund Bjl answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
A bullet clipped Edmund Bjl's helmet at R-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Konrad Danielmcmena of the Hegemony (@danielmcmenamy).
The wound on Edmund Bjl's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Edmund Bjl wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.
initial_dream8.6: Marek Dream joined the replacements on Day 4. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Marek Dream traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Marek Dream tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F21 is up. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Marek Dream helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Marek Dream had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed crossed it, Marek Dream fired. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed was badly wounded. Marek Dream's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

A beetle crawled across Marek Dream's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek Dream watched the enemy lines change the guard at R-F21 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Karel "Button" Nikola was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Marek Dream moved to a new hide at R-F21 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Quentin Arvidgrubb, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Marek Dream. Marek Dream read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
just.luke.alt: Gideon Alt arrived at R-C12 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
theelliottman: The draft reached S-S8 on Day 6. Roland Theelliottma was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. Roland Theelliottma became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Roland Theelliottma and Bastian Jt tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Roland Theelliottma gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

Roland Theelliottma held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Roland Theelliottma. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. A letter from home found Roland Theelliottma before the night shift. Roland Theelliottma folded it small and kept it close.
unseen_28_: Clement Unseen took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
